name: Hares V Tortoises - Final Demo
author: seahyx
description:
Greetings General Commander of the Hares,

You must defend the finishing line until the King of the Hares wake up to run through the race.

Hare tower cards will arrive via a conveyor-belt on the right. Strategically place these tower cards along race path to fend off relentless waves of Tortoises. With a variety of tower cards to choose from, each offering its own set of capabilities and range, you must think on your feet to ensure the finish line is not overrun by the Tortoise Army.

GOOD LUCK!!
